mapper.select: SELECT w.status FROM agent_runtime_dag_works w JOIN agent_runtime_dag_admissions a ON a.tenant_id=w.tenant_id AND a.session_id=w.session_id AND a.root_input_id=w.root_input_id WHERE w.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND w.session_id=#{session} AND w.root_input_id=#{root} AND a.task_id=#{task} AND a.run_id=#{run} AND a.agent_id=#{agent} FOR UPDATE OF w

SELECT result_id,task_id,run_id,output_name,payload::text,payload_sha256,command_sha256, invocation_id,attempt_id,created_at FROM agent_runtime_team_task_results WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND root_input_id=#{root} AND result_id=#{result}

SELECT result_id,task_id,run_id,output_name,payload::text,payload_sha256,command_sha256, invocation_id,attempt_id,created_at FROM agent_runtime_team_task_results WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND invocation_id=#{invocation} ORDER BY output_name,result_id

SELECT payload::text AS payload,payload_sha256,command_sha256,run_id,attempt_id,created_at FROM agent_runtime_team_task_results WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND session_id=#{session} AND root_input_id=#{root} AND task_id=#{task} AND run_id=#{run} ORDER BY created_at,result_id
